settings.title: Port control
settings.description: Selected ports are opened when the device has been away for the given delay and closed as soon as it is back. ★ = device with a DHCP reservation.

data_description.poll_interval: How often the router is checked, in seconds. Presence is detected with up to this delay.
data_description.schedule_enabled: When ticked, the next step asks for active hours; outside them the ports are always closed.
data_description.notify_enabled: When ticked, a next step lets you choose what to notify about and where.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate TL-ER6020
reauth_confirm.description: Login failed. Note: the router locks logins after 10 failed attempts.

schedule.title: Active hours
schedule.description: Outside these hours the controlled ports are always closed. Same time in both fields = always active.

notifications.description:

data_description.notify_services: Where to send notifications. Phones/laptops with the Home Assistant Companion app appear as notify.mobile_app_*.
data_description.send_test: Tick and press Submit to send a test to the selected channels — the form stays open. Untick to save.
